In the early days of the [[Great Galactic War]], '''a young member''' of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] fought for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] participated in the [[Minos Cluster Campaign]], specifically on the [[Battle of Eliad|battlefront]] of [[Eliad]]. During a confrontation with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces, the Sith Lord engaged the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Gnost-Dural]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] but quickly lost to the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. After the battle, Gnost-Dural took the Sith's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] for further study into the Sith society.
